name: zSentinel · Vliegende keep
goal: Clear highest-impact open P0/P1 issues, finish inherited product pull requests through protected main, and recover blocked release/runner flows across the whole portfolio.
next_step: Start with existing open product PRs: inspect exact-head required CI, independent review and any conflicts; merge only with an authorized live exclusive mainwriter lease, GitHub permission and verified default-branch commit. For HOLD or unknown-owner work, run the read-only scripts/zsentinel_issue_first_board.py --project cloud (plus up to two independent canonical projects) to prioritize observed P0/P1 issues already referenced by existing non-QA PRs. Treat PR-body references as hints, never proof of a fix or owner vacancy; inspect active Notion/queue claims before touching a task. Repair real CI/conflicts or safely deliver another freely owned P0/P1 fix; never start new QA suites, bypass security/release gates or deploy without owner authority.

milestones.title: Actively repair unowned open work across projects
